description: This Java source file defines the 'PromoServices' class, which provides a collection of static methods to manage promotional codes within the OFBiz framework. The methods include creating promo code sets, purging old store promos, importing promo codes from files, and importing promo code emails, all centered around product promotion functionalities.

classes.name: PromoServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing product promotional codes within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createProductPromoCodeSet
methods.description: Generates a set of unique product promo codes with configurable layout, length, and quantity, ensuring code uniqueness before creation.

methods.name: purgeOldStoreAutoPromos
methods.description: Removes expired promotional applications for a specific product store based on the current timestamp.

methods.name: importPromoCodesFromFile
methods.description: Reads uploaded promo codes from a file and creates promo code records in the system, reporting any errors encountered.

methods.name: importPromoCodeEmailsFromFile
methods.description: Imports email addresses from a file to associate with a promo code, creating contact mechanisms if necessary and handling errors.
